author: control_timers; producer of the component cost harness, not an independent full saved-audit reviewer

saved_evidence.scope: Read small reports and checked their file hashes only. No re-execution of saved verifier, complete oracle readback, raw reconstruction, or new independent acceptance.

negative_component_result.conclusion: The batched candidate is slower on both fixed captures. Preserve it as a negative result; do not install it, remove its safety preflight to improve the number, or infer a new600 audit will complete.
negative_component_result.guard_limit: The measurement guard performs metadata/body canonicalization and hashing. It is not the production delivered_peer validation cost and cannot be substituted for it.

call_graph.work: Read current gzip, check endpoint/arguments/clock, construct actor result. The combined reader also compares old prefix and parses the same text again.

Query active immutable requests, copy client_view and returned views, update ACK/terminal/retry/index state. A planning ACK may contain a large capture, but refresh does not validate its typed digest.

call_graph.order: singleton/schema/owner, full typed digest, finite/causal time, status/expiry, coverage/membership/job authority, completion/action coverage. Expired or otherwise later-rejected captures still paid the digest.

frequency_limits.reason: Endpoint rows do not reveal every in-process guard invocation or branch. Two owners, absent/expired captures, startup, choice/consume, cap and failures change counts. Never multiply37270 API rows by a fixed digest count.
frequency_limits.long_history_cost: latest_own_capture scans the growing outbox; BridgeOwner separately scans transfer rows and all bridge_publications. delivered_peer checks all captured job identities and authority. These source loops are hypotheses requiring actual exclusive measurements, not proven dominant costs.

progress_meaning.marker_location: bridge_saved_text_actor.py:89 retain, after current actor parse and before return to outer ObservedTape
progress_meaning.proves: Current-row tape guards, old-prefix comparison and actor construction have reached N.
progress_meaning.does_not_prove: Nth outer observer or policy consumption completed; all guards completed; final in-flight function identity; full policy/physical/all28506 certificate.
progress_meaning.existing_256row_intervals: Include intervening reads, comparisons, copies, observer work, policy work, counters and scheduling. They cannot attribute the residual to digest or any single function.

proposed_instrumentation_only.status: design only; not implemented, prepared or authorized for a full audit rerun
proposed_instrumentation_only.private_binding: Preserve defining code/defaults/closures/full globals; wrap original functions in a new private call graph. Explicitly bind the delivered_peer alias reached by startup, BridgeOwner, reuse.latest_own_capture, PossessionGate and historical assess. No global monkeypatch and no batched encoder installation.
proposed_instrumentation_only.metrics: For each fixed scope and callsite: entered/completed/raised counts, inclusive_ns, child_ns, exclusive_ns, maximum_ns. Record O(1) builtin input sizes where lawful, not fresh body hashes/copies for telemetry. Count selected digest jobs/trays at the actual call, never substitute a terminal future client history.
proposed_instrumentation_only.conservation: Synchronous stack subtracts immediate child inclusive intervals once; preserve wrapper/counter/journal cost in the owner or whole remainder. An original_digest interval is a child of delivered_peer, which may be nested inside latest_own_capture or possession_consume. Do not add inclusive totals or label source_execution pure physics.
proposed_instrumentation_only.checkpoints: Attach fixed-size aggregate counters to existing bounded progress records rather than emitting a line per query/helper. The existing actor marker must retain its meaning and include open-scope IDs; completed-owner counts update only after actual activate returns. Add a separately named end-of-observer marker if needed, not a renamed actor marker.
proposed_instrumentation_only.bounds: Preregister fixed scope IDs and exact output size/record limits with synthetic worst-count tests. Keep the existing1024 record cap; no body snapshots in telemetry and no unbounded per-call list. Any overflow/clock/write failure is sticky instrumentation-unknown and cannot yield an accepted audit.
proposed_instrumentation_only.exception_handling: Original return values/references/exceptions remain unchanged. Timer cleanup must not replace an original verifier exception; separately retain monitor failure. Resource failures introduced by instrumentation remain unknown. Keep all original digest/coverage/policy/physical/ordered/hash checks.
proposed_instrumentation_only.verification_needed_before_execution: Inverse binding/AST/code proof, reachability tests for all digest callsites, fake-clock exclusive conservation and exception tests, exact semantic replay against tiny fabricated tapes. None has been executed for this proposed instrumentation.

Preserve all envelopes and outputs, including rejection. This measures the real validator path rather than metadata guard; it does not provide activation frequencies or authenticate a new online observation.
recommended_next_small_experiment.actual_frequency_option: If actual stateful frequency is required, preregister a bounded saved-policy prefix from original time0 with an explicit API/owner cut and owned120.
